info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Retrieve Webhook Endpoint Details API
info.description: This API allows users to access detailed information about specific webhook endpoints configured in the system. By using the endpoint, consumers can retrieve essential data such as status, configuration settings, and event triggers associated with the specified webhook. Typical users include developers and system integrators who leverage webhook functionality for real-time data processing and notifications. This API is crucial for maintaining the operational integrity of webhook integrations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of a specific webhook endpoint by its unique identifier. You can use this to get information about the webhook's configuration and status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve webhook endpoint details for a specific resource. Ensure that the request conforms to the expected JSON schema for accurate results.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource is returned.

GetWebhookEndpointByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the webhook endpoint related to operations. It is expected to be a string type that provides the necessary input data.

GetWebhookEndpointByIdResponse_200.title: Webhook Endpoint Response

webhookEndpointId.description: The unique identifier for the webhook endpoint.

merchantId.description: The unique identifier for the merchant associated with the webhook endpoint.

url.description: The URL to which the webhook events will be delivered.

description.description: A description of the webhook endpoint.

events.description: The list of events that trigger the webhook.

items.description: An event type for the webhook.

status.description: The current status of the webhook endpoint (e.g., active, inactive).

secretLastRotatedAt.description: The timestamp when the secret for the webhook endpoint was last rotated.

lastDeliveryAt.description: The timestamp when the last delivery attempt was made.

lastDeliveryStatus.description: The status of the last delivery attempt.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the webhook endpoint.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the webhook endpoint.
